title: Aleksei Larionov — floating depth gallery and breathing cymatics
note: Two ideas in one save. A depth-layered gallery that drifts with parallax and zooms into a hero panel, and UI Sound Cymatics — Chladni-style contour lines that ripple as you drag and breathe at rest. Her steals: cymatics as a Play piece and a first step toward her birthday music visualiser, and click-to-centre zoom for the Play canvas. Demo: https://ui-sound-cymatics.vercel.app — gallery post: https://x.com/dsgn_aleksei/status/2116149656484986894
